 "data": "flowchart TD
 subgraph Client [\"Partition: Boundary (Client UI)\"]
 A([● Start]) --> B[Input Search Parameters]
 B --> C[Submit Search Request]
 F[Select Desk & Confirm Slot] --> G[Submit Booking Request]
 P[Receive Booking QR Pass] --> Q[Scan QR Code at Terminal]
 end

 subgraph Backend [\"Partition: Control (Application Logic)\"]
 C --> D[Query Available Inventory]
 D --> E{Desks Available?}
 
 G --> H[Acquire Transaction Lock]
 H --> I{Lock Granted?}
 
 Q --> R[Validate Token & Time Window]
 R --> S{Token Valid?}
 
 S -- Yes --> T[Update Status: CHECKED_IN]
 S -- No --> U[Update Status: NO_SHOW]
 end

 subgraph Data [\"Partition: Persistence & Gateways\"]
 FORK(( )) --> J1[(Save Reservation Record)]
 FORK(( )) --> J2[Dispatch Confirmation Email]
 
 J1 --> JOIN(( ))
 J2 --> JOIN
 end

 E -- No --> B
 E -- Yes --> F
 
 I -- No --> F
 I -- Yes --> FORK

 JOIN --> P

 T --> Z([◉ End])
 U --> Z",
 "config": null
